ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Compressed visual tokens for interleaved reasoning in a 7B unified model
PROPOSAL: Fine-tune Janus-Pro-7B on 40000 jigsaw and maze-navigation chains in which a reasoning step emits text followed by a visual state image, with the image encoded as 64 compressed tokens by a learned bottleneck instead of 576. Train in 2 stages, text-and-image alignment first, then chain-level optimization with learning rate 2e-5. Evaluate on a held-out jigsaw set of 2000 puzzles and a navigation benchmark of 1000 mazes, reporting exact-match accuracy across both sets, wall-clock per chain and peak sequence length, with 3 seeds.
CONTROLS: text-only reasoning chains; full-resolution visual tokens; programmatic crop-and-draw operations; a variant without the second stage
COST: 1500
PREDICTION: Accuracy stays within 2 points of full-resolution tokens at roughly a quarter of the sequence length; it fails if the bottleneck loses the piece-boundary detail that jigsaw ordering needs.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Bottleneck levels for visual chains in 7B and 13B unified models
PROPOSAL: Fine-tune Janus-Pro-7B and a 13B variant on jigsaw, maze-navigation and rearrangement chains in which a reasoning step emits text followed by a visual state image, with the image encoded by a learned bottleneck at 4 compression levels. Train in 3 stages with the learning rate reduced between stages. Evaluate on held-out sets of 2000 puzzles, 1000 mazes and 1000 rearrangement scenes, reporting exact-match accuracy, wall-clock per chain and peak sequence length, with 3 seeds, and compare decoding speed at small and large batch sizes, with the share of valid final states.
CONTROLS: text-only reasoning chains; full-resolution visual tokens; programmatic crop-and-draw operations; a variant trained in 2 stages only
COST: 1500
PREDICTION: Accuracy changes by under 2 points under the compression levels, and the 13B model gains modestly over the 7B one on mazes.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Sparse attention over visual history for long multi-modal chains
PROPOSAL: Starting from Bagel-7B, replace full attention over earlier steps with a scheme in which text tokens of past steps are attended fully but image tokens of past steps are attended only through 32 pooled summary tokens. Fine-tune on 60000 chains spanning jigsaw solving, navigation maps and image editing with reasoning, with sequences of up to 8 steps, in 2 phases at learning rate 2e-5. Evaluate on 2000 jigsaw puzzles, 1500 editing instructions and 800 reasoning-driven generation prompts, reporting accuracy, an automatic image-quality score, peak memory and speed, with 3 seeds.
CONTROLS: Bagel-7B with full attention; Bagel-7B with text-only chains; a sliding-window variant of the same budget; pooling replaced by random token dropping
COST: 2500
PREDICTION: Pooled summaries keep accuracy within 2 points of full attention while cutting memory sharply; editing quality drops if fine textures of earlier images are needed later.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Attention schemes for long multi-modal chains across model sizes
PROPOSAL: Starting from Bagel-7B, a 14B variant and a 3B variant, compare full attention, a sliding window over recent steps, pooled summaries of 16 to 64 tokens per image, and random token dropping at 50% for image tokens of earlier steps. Fine-tune on 90000 chains spanning jigsaw solving, navigation maps and image editing with reasoning, with sequences of up to 8 steps. Evaluate on 2000 jigsaw puzzles, 1500 editing instructions and 800 reasoning-driven generation prompts, reporting accuracy, an automatic image-quality score, peak memory and speed, with 3 seeds.
CONTROLS: full attention at all 3 model sizes; text-only chains; a sliding-window variant of the same budget
COST: 2500
PREDICTION: The ranking of attention schemes is the same at 3B, 7B and 14B; pooled summaries match full attention within 2 points, though the speed gains differ with the sizes.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Stabilizing interleaved training with a staged curriculum on Show-o
PROPOSAL: Fine-tune Show-o 1.3B on 30000 chains from jigsaw, navigation and topographic-map landscape tasks using a curriculum with 3 stages: text-only chains first, then chains with 1 visual step, then up to 6. A balancing term scales the image loss to the text loss using a running ratio. Track gradient norm spikes and loss curves across training, and evaluate on 1000 jigsaw puzzles and 600 landscape generation prompts with accuracy and a CLIP-based alignment score, using 5 seeds.
CONTROLS: joint training from the start; fixed loss weights of 1.0 and 0.5; a curriculum without the balancing term; text-only reasoning fine-tuning
COST: 900
PREDICTION: The curriculum lowers gradient-spike counts and raises jigsaw accuracy by a few points; landscape alignment improves little.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Loss balancing schedules for interleaved image-text chains across backbones
PROPOSAL: Fine-tune Show-o 1.3B and Janus-Pro-1B on 30000 chains from jigsaw, navigation and topographic-map landscape tasks, with image-to-text loss ratios at 4 values, warmup schedules of 2 lengths, and gradient clipping at 3 thresholds, halving the learning rate at the midpoint of training. Track gradient norm spikes and loss curves, and evaluate on 1000 jigsaw puzzles and 600 landscape generation prompts with accuracy and a CLIP-based alignment score, using 3 seeds, and compare the spike counts for the backbones.
CONTROLS: joint training with fixed loss weights of 1.0 and 0.5; a curriculum from text-only chains; text-only reasoning fine-tuning; no clipping
COST: 900
PREDICTION: Instability is driven mostly by the ratio, not by warmup length; moderate ratios behave alike, and clipping thresholds change barely.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Unified 14B model trained end to end with image supervision during reasoning
PROPOSAL: Train a 14B unified model, initialised from a pretrained understanding-and-generation checkpoint, on 400000 reasoning chains drawn from jigsaw puzzles, navigation maps, rearrangement scenes and topographic-contour landscapes. The loss combines next-token prediction on text with a diffusion objective on the visual state images produced along the chain, up to 6 images per chain, in 3 stages. Evaluate on 2000 jigsaw puzzles, 2000 reasoning-driven generation prompts, 1500 editing instructions and 1000 visual questions, with 10 seeds, reporting accuracy and automatic image-quality scores.
CONTROLS: a 7B model trained the same way; text-only chains of thought at 14B; an external image generator paired with the language model; images supervised only at the last step
COST: 4000
PREDICTION: Step-level image supervision improves jigsaw accuracy and navigation over last-step supervision; the external generator produces less coherent state transitions on rearrangement.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Visual-state supervision schedule for a 3B model on landscape and puzzle chains
PROPOSAL: Using a 3B unified model from a comparable checkpoint, train on 150000 chains of contour-map landscapes and jigsaw puzzles with 4 weightings of the image loss relative to the text loss, supervising either the final image only or the full sequence of up to 6 images. Training proceeds in 3 stages, and a held-out evaluation covers 2000 puzzles, 2000 generation prompts and 1000 visual questions with accuracy and automatic image-quality scores, re-run over 10 seeds, with image-quality statistics logged at 3 checkpoints and puzzle-state images scored by a rule-based checker.
CONTROLS: a 1.5B model trained likewise; text-only chains at 3B; an external generator paired with the language model
COST: 4000
PREDICTION: Full-sequence supervision beats final-image supervision on puzzles, while landscape quality changes slightly over the 4 weightings.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Latent visual states instead of pixel images for reasoning steps
PROPOSAL: Train a 7B model to emit, after a reasoning step, 8 continuous latent vectors predicted by a regression head, with a small decoder rendering them to an image only for evaluation. Use 50000 maze-navigation and jigsaw chains, with the decoder frozen after the first of 2 stages. Evaluate on 1000 mazes and 2000 puzzles, reporting accuracy and sequence length, and decode latents for 200 chains to inspect visual coherence by 2 annotators, with 3 seeds.
CONTROLS: explicit image tokens at 576 tokens per step; text-only reasoning; a decoder trained jointly rather than frozen
COST: 1200
PREDICTION: Latents cut sequence length by roughly an order of magnitude and keep accuracy near explicit images; jigsaw accuracy drops because 8 vectors lose local texture.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Visual token vocabulary size for generated state images
PROPOSAL: Train a 7B model whose visual states are quantized into discrete codes from codebooks of 4096 to 65536 entries, with images generated in sequence at 256 tokens per state. Use 90000 rearrangement, navigation and jigsaw chains and keep the vision tower frozen in the first stage of training. Evaluate on 1000 mazes, 2000 puzzles and 800 rearrangement scenes, reporting accuracy, code error and sequence length, with 3 seeds, and rate visual coherence on 200 chains with 2 annotators, comparing code error against length.
CONTROLS: explicit continuous image features; text-only reasoning; a vision tower trained rather than frozen; codebooks learned jointly
COST: 1200
PREDICTION: Accuracy rises with codebook size up to a moderate point and then flattens; reconstruction error keeps falling without helping puzzle accuracy on the benchmark.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Reward shaping from visual-state consistency for jigsaw and navigation
PROPOSAL: Starting from a supervised 7B checkpoint, apply policy-gradient training with a reward combining final-answer correctness and a consistency score between predicted visual states and those produced by a rule-based simulator for jigsaw and 2D navigation. Use 30000 prompts, groups of 8 samples per prompt, and a KL penalty of 0.02. Evaluate on 2000 puzzles and 1000 mazes with 3 seeds, reporting accuracy, consistency score and mean chain length across 3 training stages.
CONTROLS: supervised checkpoint only; policy-gradient with answer reward only; reward from an external learned reward model; text-only chains
COST: 2000
PREDICTION: Consistency reward increases accuracy by a few points over answer-only reward and shortens chains; it may fail when the simulator's state differs from valid alternative solutions.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Reward ablation for visual reasoning in 5 domains
PROPOSAL: Starting from a supervised 7B checkpoint, apply policy-gradient training with a reward combining final-answer correctness and a consistency score between predicted visual states and simulator states, over jigsaw, navigation, rearrangement, geometry and topographic-map tasks. Use 100000 prompts, groups of 8 samples per prompt, KL penalties at 3 values, and reward weights at 4 values. Evaluate on 2000 puzzles and 1000 mazes plus 500 items from the other domains, with 3 seeds.
CONTROLS: supervised checkpoint only; policy-gradient with answer reward only; reward from an external learned reward model; text-only chains
COST: 2000
PREDICTION: KL strength matters less than the reward mix; consistency reward helps most on jigsaw and navigation.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Data mixture for text-and-image reasoning chains on 1.3B models
PROPOSAL: Fine-tune Show-o 1.3B on mixtures of 3 chain sources, 20000 jigsaw chains, 20000 navigation chains and 20000 editing-with-reasoning chains, comparing 3 mixture proportions that upweight one source at a time. Evaluate on 1000 puzzles, 1000 mazes and 800 editing instructions with exact match and an automatic editing score, with 5 seeds. The aim is to see whether chains transfer between tasks at a controlled length of 4 steps.
CONTROLS: training on one source alone; a mixture without visual steps; text-only reasoning fine-tuning
COST: 700
PREDICTION: Navigation chains transfer to jigsaw modestly while editing chains transfer poorly; balanced mixtures do about as well as the best source alone.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Mixture proportions and source scale for visual chains
PROPOSAL: Fine-tune Show-o 1.3B, Janus-Pro-1B and a 7B model on mixtures of 5 chain sources of 20000 chains, jigsaw, navigation, editing, geometry and landscape, comparing 6 mixture proportions and curricula that order sources by difficulty. Evaluate on 1000 puzzles, 1000 mazes and 800 editing instructions with exact match and an automatic editing score, with 8 seeds, controlling sequence length to 4 steps, and report transfer as accuracy on sources held out of training, with confidence intervals over seeds.
CONTROLS: training on one source alone; a mixture without visual steps; text-only reasoning fine-tuning
COST: 700
PREDICTION: Proportions matter hardly once all sources are present; the 7B model transfers among sources better than the 1.3B models.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Pretraining a unified 14B model from scratch on interleaved chains
PROPOSAL: Pretrain a 14B unified model on 300 billion tokens of interleaved image-text documents, then run chain-of-thought fine-tuning with up to 8 visual states per chain on 200000 chains from jigsaw, navigation, rearrangement and contour-map landscape tasks. Use a 3-stage schedule, 2 image tokenizers at 256 and 1024 tokens per image, and vary the share of interleaved data at 25% and 75%. Evaluate on 2000 puzzles, 2000 generation prompts, 1500 editing instructions and 1000 visual questions, with 2 seeds.
CONTROLS: a 7B model with the same pretraining recipe; text-only pretraining followed by the same fine-tuning; fine-tuning an existing unified checkpoint; programmatic visual operations
COST: 5000
PREDICTION: Interleaved pretraining improves long-chain accuracy beyond fine-tuning alone, with the 1024-token tokenizer better on editing and the 256-token one near-equal on mazes.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Share of interleaved data when fine-tuning an existing 7B checkpoint
PROPOSAL: Start from an existing 7B unified checkpoint and continue training on 2 billion tokens of interleaved image-text documents with the interleaved share at 10%, 25%, 50% and 75%, then run chain fine-tuning with up to 8 visual states on 100000 chains from jigsaw, navigation, rearrangement and contour-map landscape tasks. Use 2 image tokenizers at 256 and 1024 tokens per image. Evaluate on 2000 puzzles, 2000 generation prompts, 1500 editing instructions and 1000 visual questions, with 5 seeds.
CONTROLS: the checkpoint with chain fine-tuning only; text-only continued training followed by the same fine-tuning; programmatic visual operations
COST: 5000
PREDICTION: Gains peak near a 25% share and decline afterwards; the tokenizer choice moves editing scores but not mazes, and the lowest share underperforms on editing prompts that need long context.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Critique-and-revise loops for reasoning-driven image generation on Bagel-7B
PROPOSAL: Fine-tune Bagel-7B so that after drafting an image it writes a short critique of mismatches with the prompt and regenerates, with at most 2 revision rounds, using 60000 synthetic critique chains. Evaluate on GenEval, WISE and 800 held-out reasoning-driven prompts, reporting attribute accuracy and an automatic alignment score together with sequence length per prompt, with 3 seeds.
CONTROLS: Bagel-7B with direct generation; Bagel-7B with text-only reasoning before generation; an external critic paired with the generator
COST: 3000
PREDICTION: Critique-and-revise raises WISE scores on prompts needing world knowledge, at the cost of roughly doubled sequence length; it may fail where the critique repeats the prompt instead of inspecting the draft.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Revision depth and critic scale for reasoning-driven generation
PROPOSAL: Fine-tune Bagel-7B, a 14B model and Janus-Pro-7B with critique-and-revise loops of 1 to 4 rounds on 200000 synthetic critique chains, training in 3 stages with a lower learning rate for the generation head. Evaluate on GenEval, WISE, ImgEdit and 1500 held-out reasoning-driven prompts, reporting attribute accuracy, an automatic alignment score and sequence length per prompt, with 5 seeds, and compare critique lengths of short, medium and long.
CONTROLS: direct generation at all 3 backbones; text-only reasoning before generation; an external critic paired with the generator
COST: 3000
PREDICTION: Gains saturate after 2 rounds, and the 14B model improves WISE by under 2 points over the 7B ones, with ImgEdit changing least.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Does drawing a sketch before answering help visual questions on Show-o
PROPOSAL: Fine-tune Show-o 1.3B on 25000 geometry and map-reading questions with sketch-then-answer chains in 2 stages, and test on 1200 held-out questions from MathVista geometry subsets and 800 navigation questions, with exact-match accuracy and answer-length statistics across question types, with 10 seeds. Break down accuracy by whether the sketch is correct according to a rule-based checker, and by question type.
CONTROLS: answer-only fine-tuning; text-only chains of thought; a sketch generated after the answer; a sketch from an external drawing tool
COST: 600
PREDICTION: Sketch-then-answer helps most on map-reading and little on algebraic geometry; wrong sketches carry wrong answers, so accuracy is bounded by sketch quality.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Sketch fidelity and scale for visual question answering with a 7B model
PROPOSAL: Fine-tune a 7B model on 25000 map-reading questions with sketch-then-answer chains in 3 stages, with sketch resolution at 3 levels and image-loss weights at 4 values. Test on 800 navigation questions with exact-match accuracy, answer length and sketch coherence ratings from 2 annotators, with 10 seeds, and break down the results by route length and by sketch correctness.
CONTROLS: answer-only fine-tuning; text-only chains of thought; a sketch generated after the answer
COST: 600
PREDICTION: Accuracy rises from the lowest to the middle resolution and then flattens; image-loss weight has a small effect once sketches are legible.
